title: ‘Not an isolated incident’: Russian drones stalk Ukraine’s civilians in ‘human safaris’
summary: The video of a Ukrainian cyclist being targeted and killed by a short-range drone posted – and later deleted – by the Russian military Friday left viewers outraged and shaken. But it’s not the first time that Russian drone operators have been accused of terrorising Ukrainian civilians by deliberately targeting them in “human safaris” denounced as a war crim…
